implementation: Independent captured master/renamed-file recycling defaults, including stored nonzero values.
Working-file replacements and distinct old-name collisions obey policy; additions, baseline restoration, symlinks and gitlink handling retain existing semantics.

Commit, Add, dedicated Revert, Resolve and Rebase confirmations hand their captured policy to shared progress, including custom executors; Working Tree routes through Revert. Retry retains approved policy while refreshing selected status.
Progress totals and saved-copy actions reflect actual Trash operations only; cancellation/failure preserve actual prior receipts without claiming unsaved bytes recoverable.
Focused status repair: safely lstat only existing staged-deletion candidates, retaining ignored recreated regular/symlink local-copy metadata without restoring a global ignored-file scan.

retained_operation.initial_compile_error: Fixture called status(includeIgnored:) without required readPolicy; repaired to existing status() API, same versioned-row filtering/assertions. No receiver launched by failed compile.

resolve_rebase_custom_executors.rebase_system_failure: Existing Deleted local copy lost Add/Delete assertion; owned receiver reaped after cleanup. Bundled Rebase was not attempted by this initial group.

native.scope: Retained Revert operation, Resolve mutation and Rebase conflict files, each with system and bundled Git. Retained/Resolve passing cases predate only the targeted status-metadata repair; only affected Rebase cases were repeated.

dialog_coverage.meaning: Review ledger regenerated after documentation freeze; no feature completion percentage.

status_repair.cause: Rebase existing Add/Delete assertion failed after the no-Trash policy scenario passed: includeIgnored:false dropped duplicate !! metadata for a recreated ignored staged deletion.

resolve_table_reentrancy.cause: No synchronous application row-delegate reload cause established by bounded source review; no warning repair or new-regression claim.

validation.runner_ownership: Existing conflict-family runner now hides every ordered window/sheet offscreen and drains owned operation/release counters on success and failure. Receiver groups are terminated and reaped by native_receiver; no user app process is targeted.

limits: No full hosted macOS pass, signed installed/physical Finder acceptance, App Store distribution or complete dialog parity is claimed.
The default Core API retains recycling; native consumers supply the captured originating preferences.
Existing stronger old-name obstruction protection is a documented macOS adaptation; disabling backup does not disable preflight.
